chapter: New Orleans musicians, recordings and radio
title: Perry Bradford's Mean Four sides in 1926
summary: Albertson mentions "Don't Forget to Mess Around" and "Heebie-Jeebies"; she recalls the songs but not the group.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Oh, you have those? I see. But I was going to ask you about the other day when we were talking about recordings -- we're skipping around, probably going to drive the people crazy listening to this tape, but it can't be helped.
In 1926 in New York you recorded with Perry Bradford's Mean Four, "Don't Forget To Mess Around" and "Heebie-Jeebies."
Do you remember who was in that group?
Perry Bradford's? No. But you can find all that in this thing. Perry Bradford's got all that down.
